title: Orphan ratchet baseline
description: Reviewed intentional exceptions (OW-07), one concrete reason per entry. Remove entries when they become reachable or are retired. A new offline acceptance seam requires a reviewed reason identifying its real consumers and qualification boundary; this is not a backlog allowance for unwired production code.
